lines.cobblemon.species.pikachu-alola.desc: This Pikachu is wearing its Trainer's cap. Since the cap's not the right size, the fit is a bit loose.
lines.cobblemon.species.pikachu-alolabias.desc: This Pokémon has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while Pikachu sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.
lines.cobblemon.species.pikachu-gmax.desc: Its Gigantamax power expanded, forming its supersized body and towering tail.
